data.title: PR-22A IMPL-02: custom incremental engine spike with four reuse-edge classes, explain_invalidation, independent parity audit

data.body:
[HIGH] Cache hits erase the class that licensed their contents and bypass class-scoped quarantine. decide starts every hit as Exact here. A Conservative hit then refreshes side identities without recomputation at lines 746-760, while demand stores a Validated result without its class or witness at lines 849-870. The next identical revision is therefore Exact. If parity quarantines the actual Conservative or Validated triple, admit checks the different Exact triple and Promotion serves the suspect output again. This violates RFC 0030: no in-place class upgrade, and quarantined results must be re-derived. Preserve the origin class and evidence on Entry, meet that origin into later decisions, and evict or recompute entries whose origin triple is quarantined.

Risk-high questions:
- Failure modes: a stale Conservative output or bad Validated output survives the exact quarantine intended to force recomputation.
- Edge cases: both the side-input refresh path and the Validated insertion path launder provenance; an Interactive result can later enter Promotion.
- Rollback: disable non-Exact cache insertion and side refresh until Entry preserves provenance, then advance affected function versions.
- Monitoring: reject or alert when an Exact record comes from a non-Exact cache origin, and when a post-quarantine rerun does not recompute.
- Validation: inject divergent Conservative and Validated results, quarantine the blamed triple, then assert the identical rerun recomputes and reaches clean parity.

[HIGH] Invariant checking evaluates only the main predicate and never its generated definedness companion. CML lowering emits name#defined for partial map reads at crates/continuum-cml-elab/src/lower.rs:1686-1706. Missing integer-coded map entries can still decode to the base value at lower/collections.rs:1787-1815, so a predicate such as a missing read equal to that base can evaluate true while the companion is false. This loop returns Holds. The clean audit repeats the omission at audit.rs:135-159, so parity also passes. Consult the companion for every state and return a distinct typed undefined-read outcome before any Holds result.

Risk-high questions:
- Failure modes: a model with an undefined map read receives a false Holds verdict, and the independent audit certifies parity for the same wrong answer.
- Edge cases: absent keys that decode to the base value, nested reads, and keys that become absent only after a transition can all hide the defect.
- Rollback: reject invariant checking for models with partial map reads until both paths implement definedness.
- Monitoring: count false definedness companions and prohibit Holds whenever any companion is false or missing.
- Validation: add a reachable absent-key model whose main predicate evaluates true, require a typed non-Holds result, and mutation-test either path so shared omission cannot pass parity.

[MEDIUM] The value documented as the canonical state graph omits the successor relation. It serializes states, depths, first-discovery edges, and aggregate counts only. Two graphs can share all of those fields while differing in non-tree transitions, so they receive identical bytes. Because the clean audit shares this encoder, it can report parity for different graphs and miss the dependency defect it must detect. Encode canonical sorted successor rows, or a digest over them, and add a negative case with the same BFS tree and transition count but different non-tree edges.

[MEDIUM] The Validated path compares only certificate kind and model_digest after the independent checker accepts the wire bytes. It does not bind the checked claim to the expected semantic_epoch, property_digest, scope_digest, assumptions_digest, producer, or domain_pack_digests constructed at lines 1263-1270. A producer defect can therefore emit a valid certificate for a different envelope and this engine still labels the current query Validated. Compare every expected envelope field after checking, then add one rejection test per mutated binding.

data.reason: Two high-severity soundness defects block approval: cache provenance laundering bypasses class-scoped quarantine, and partial-map definedness is ignored by both invariant paths. The canonical graph and certificate-envelope findings also require correction. This vote does not satisfy or alter any separate risk:critical human-approval gate.
